english: I hadn't yet decided what I would do once I had returned, but circumstances had conspired to force a choice upon me. Should I protect these helpless villagers by attacking the bandits or should I help the bandits keep these peasants in their place? No doubt my actions here will dictate the future of the land.
chinese: 归来后该做什么，我原本还没有决定，局势却逼我作出选择：是攻击匪徒，保护这些无助的村民；还是帮助匪徒，让农民继续受他们压迫？毫无疑问，我在这里的所作所为将决定这片土地的未来。

english: This is the beginning of something new...something good. I went against my upbringing and attacked the bandits to protect the peasants. I've started something here, and I must finish the job: I must kill all attacking bandits and save the village, and not lose my life doing so.
chinese: 一个新的开始……也许是好的开始。我违背了从小接受的教导，攻击匪徒，保护农民。既然已经走出这一步，我就必须把事情做完：杀死所有来犯的匪徒，拯救村庄，还得活下来。

chinese: Otomo 说得对——信蛇打算顽抗到底。只要摧毁他的要塞，当面与他交锋，他就该听得进道理。毕竟，我是灵蛇帝国的继承人。不过，我的新阵营缺乏领导；如果我死了，它必定分崩离析。

chinese: 信蛇的雇佣兵已被扫清，他无处可逃。摧毁他在北方的要塞并击败他，这场追猎便会结束。他对我的家族仍有忠心；只要我活过这一战，他一定会加入我们。

english: Shinja's mercenaries again...this rabble should fall easily. If I kill them all, this province will join my cause. If I survive, the Clan will grow.
chinese: 又是信蛇的雇佣兵……这群乌合之众应该不难对付。杀光他们，这片行省就会支持我的事业。只要我活下来，阵营就能壮大。

english: Shinja has always had a talent for escape, but we've cornered him now - that snake doesn't have anywhere else to run. If we defeat him in battle, I can surely sway him to our cause. I must survive if we're to enlist his aid.
chinese: 信蛇一向善于逃脱，但这次我们把他逼到了绝境——那条蛇再也无处可逃。只要在战斗中击败他，我一定能说服他加入我们。要争取他的协助，我必须活下来。
status: 已确认专名离线修订，待实机验证

english: The Wolf miners...I never thought I'd be fighting against them. As much as it pains me, we have no choice but to fight - we should clear them away and move on to the Swan's Pool. The Geisha trust me, so I must survive if we're to reclaim the Orb.
chinese: 恶狼族矿工……我从没想过会与他们交战。虽然痛心，我们别无选择，只能击退他们，继续前往 Swan's Pool。艺妓信任我；要夺回宝珠，我必须活下来。
note: Narrative draft; names retained in English; paired quote attribution remains separate

english: The keys to claiming this province are the two villages. I expect some kind of encounter in the second, given the guard's warnings about the Lotus. A display of power will sway the people here, but I mustn't get careless and die if we're to reclaim the Orb from the Geisha.
chinese: 夺取这片行省的关键在于两座村庄。卫兵警告过莲花族的事，第二座村庄恐怕会有一场冲突。展现实力才能赢得这里的民心；但若想从艺妓手中夺回宝珠，我就不能大意丧命。
note: Narrative draft; names retained in English; paired quote attribution remains separate；保留原文边缘空格供拼接。

english: So, it would seem that this Vetkin is behind all of this...I hope Lord Garrin is all right. I've no idea why the noble Wolf Clan would side with Vetkin, but we must clear them away and move on to the Swan's Pool. The Geisha trust me, so it's imperative that I survive this encounter.
chinese: 看来这一切的幕后主使就是 Vetkin……希望 Garrin 大人平安无事。我不明白高尚的恶狼族为何会与 Vetkin 为伍，但我们必须击退他们，继续前往 Swan's Pool。艺妓信任我，所以我绝不能死在这一战。
note: Narrative draft; names retained in English; paired quote attribution remains separate

english: The Lotus...I've never trusted them, and it seems my suspicions were well-founded. If we're to free this province, we'll need to defeat the Master Warlock who controls the locals. The Geisha trust me, so I must be on my guard if we're to reclaim the Orb...
chinese: 莲花族……我从未信任过他们，如今看来我的怀疑并非空穴来风。要解放这片行省，就必须击败控制当地人的高级魔法师。艺妓信任我；要夺回宝珠，我必须小心行事……
note: Narrative draft; names retained in English; paired quote attribution remains separate

english: Our enemies have come for the Serpent's Orb - how did they know it was here? Regardless, we must protect the Geisha’s home at all costs if we're to earn their trust and claim the Orb.
chinese: 敌人是冲着巨蛇宝珠来的——他们怎么知道宝珠在这里？无论如何，若想赢得艺妓的信任并取得宝珠，就必须不惜一切代价守住她们的家园。
note: 与 WOTW 对应条目英文原文完全相同，复用逐条审阅的译文。

english: The Wolf Clan have changed much while I was away - they're certainly stronger than before. As much as it pains me, we must defeat them and hurry to Serpentholm - the Orb is in danger of falling into the wrong hands.
chinese: 我离开后，恶狼族变了许多，实力也比从前更强。虽然令人痛心，我们仍必须击败他们，赶往 Serpentholm——宝珠正面临落入不轨之徒手中的危险。
note: Narrative draft; names retained in English; paired quote attribution remains separate

english: The Lotus Clan has always had a problem with Serpent authority. The only way to protect my people is to completely wipe them out, leaving neither man nor mortar standing. I cannot fail - we're getting too close.
chinese: 莲花族一向不服灵蛇族的统治。要保护我的人民，唯一的办法就是将他们彻底消灭，不留一兵一卒、一砖一瓦。我不能失败——我们离目标已经很近了。
note: Narrative draft; names retained in English; paired quote attribution remains separate

english: Many battles have been fought on these grounds, but none so fierce as this. As this will be the new seat of the Dragon Clan's republic, we must leave no trace of the opposition or we compromise the Clan's security forever.
chinese: 这片土地历经无数战役，但从未有过如此惨烈的一战。这里将成为神龙族共和国的新都城；我们必须彻底清除敌军，否则阵营的安全将永远受到威胁。
note: Narrative draft; names retained in English; paired quote attribution remains separate；保留原文边缘空格供拼接。

english: I've never understood Kenji's soft spot for the Wolf Clan - I suppose they're easier to like if you've been vacationing for the last seven years. If our new clan is to flourish, we must wipe out the Wolf Clan and leave none of their hovels standing. We can now build a Keep to house our Zen Masters, so protecting our leaders is no longer crucial to victory.
chinese: 我一直不明白健治为何对恶狼族格外宽容。也许离开七年的人比较容易喜欢他们。要让我们的新阵营兴旺，就必须消灭恶狼族，连他们的破屋也一间不留。我们现在能建造要塞，让禅师驻扎其中，因此首领是否安然无恙已不再决定胜负。
status: 已确认专名离线修订，待实机验证

english: You can take the Wolf out of the mines, but I guess you can't take the mines out of the Wolf. There are three mines here and we should destroy all of them. They've also built a Cairn at some "nexus" to the East, which will also need to fall. We can now build a Keep to house our Zen Masters, so protecting our leaders is no longer critical.
chinese: 让恶狼族离开矿井容易，让矿井从他们心里消失却难。这里有三座矿井，必须全部摧毁。他们还在东边一处所谓的“交汇点”建了石冢，也必须将它摧毁。现在我们可以建造要塞供禅师驻扎，因此保护首领已不再是获胜的必要条件。
note: Narrative draft; names retained in English; paired quote attribution remains separate

english: The Lotus are shaping up to be quite the adversary. I'm sure that even Kenji would agree that they all must be taught a lesson - we'll wipe out all of their people and buildings and move on. We can now build a Keep to house our Zen Masters, so protecting our leaders is no longer essential.
chinese: 莲花族正成为相当棘手的对手。我敢说，就连健治也会同意给他们一个教训——消灭他们所有人和建筑，再继续前进。现在我们能建造要塞供禅师驻守，因此保护领袖不再是必需的。
status: 已确认专名离线修订，待实机验证

english: I never remembered this province being so desolate. I know we're getting close, and it's not because of the smell of burning flesh. The Dragon is here, waiting for me at the spire...I just know it. I must meet with him - perhaps his power is the key to ending this war.
chinese: 我不记得这片行省曾如此荒凉。我知道我们快到了，倒不是因为闻到了烧焦的血肉味。神龙就在这里，在尖塔等着我……我确信如此。我必须去见它，也许它的力量正是结束战争的关键。
note: Narrative draft; names retained in English; paired quote attribution remains separate

english: The Dragon has issued a challenge - I must brave the gauntlet of the Dragon's Spire and meet it at the mountain's summit. This trial is sure to be difficult, but if I survive I'll have the Dragon's favor.
chinese: 神龙向我发出了挑战。我必须闯过神龙尖塔的重重考验，在山顶与它相见。试炼必定艰难，但只要活下来，我就能得到神龙的眷顾。
note: Narrative draft; names retained in English; paired quote attribution remains separate

english: Betrayed! I should have seen this coming. There's a village to the East which can provide us with supplies and a work force. If we gain their support we should have no problem wiping out the Lotus and returning to Serpentholm and punishing those responsible.
chinese: 被背叛了！我早该料到。东边有座村庄，可以为我们提供补给和人手。若能获得村民支持，我们便能消灭莲花族、重返 Serpentholm，惩罚那些罪魁祸首。
note: Narrative draft; names retained in English; paired quote attribution remains separate

english: The traitor Shinja must be defeated! He's resurrected the old Serpent guard, built himself a fine Keep and allied himself with the Lotus - all must fall. Shinja will pay for what he did to you, Otomo!
chinese: 必须打败叛徒信蛇！他重建了旧灵蛇卫队，修起一座像样的要塞，还与莲花族结盟——这些都必须摧毁。Otomo，信蛇要为他对你做的一切付出代价！

english: The Ninja are bound by the mysterious Soul Flame...if we destroy its pedestal to extinguish the flame, they'll be bound to us. We're not prepared to build a town here, so we must use our forces carefully.
chinese: 忍者受到神秘魂火的束缚……只要摧毁底座、熄灭火焰，他们就会受我们驱使。我们无法在这里建造城镇，因此必须谨慎运用现有兵力。
note: 与 WOTW 对应条目英文原文完全相同，复用逐条审阅的译文。

english: The Lotus have allied with the Ninja and would prevent me from allying with the Monks. If we destroy the Lotus outpost and weather the Ninja's attacks we will be victorious, provided that the Monastery is still standing.
chinese: 莲花族与忍者结盟，阻止我争取僧侣。只要摧毁莲花族的前哨，抵御忍者的进攻，并确保寺院仍然屹立，我们就能获胜。
note: 与 WOTW 对应条目英文原文完全相同，复用逐条审阅的译文。

english: This is the last province before we arrive on the Lotus home plateau. Obliterating the Lotus here is the only option.
chinese: 这是抵达莲花族故乡高原前的最后一个省份。除了在这里消灭莲花族，我们别无选择。
note: 与 WOTW 对应条目英文原文完全相同，复用逐条审阅的译文。

english: Zymeth is using the orb, no doubt - if we besiege his forces he should show himself. Once we kill Zymeth, this should all be over...
chinese: Zymeth 毫无疑问正在使用宝珠——只要围攻他的军队，他应该就会现身。杀死 Zymeth，一切就该结束了……
note: 与 WOTW 对应条目英文原文完全相同，复用逐条审阅的译文。 人名依术语基线暂保留英文。

english: The Horde, the Dragon Clan's legendary foe, still lives and comes to infest our land. If we survive their attacks long enough it should draw out their leader, this "Nightvol." Killing that monster is our goal.
chinese: 神龙族传说中的宿敌——大群——仍然存在，如今又来侵扰我们的土地。只要我们撑过足够久的进攻，他们的首领，那个叫“Nightvol”的家伙应该就会现身。杀死那个怪物就是我们的目标。
note: 与 WOTW 对应条目英文原文完全相同，复用逐条审阅的译文。 Horde 暂译大群；Nightvol 保留英文，待专名核验。 人名依术语基线暂保留英文。

english: These Peasants need to learn their place and serve as an example to others that might rebel. If I kill them all and survive the encounter, the Serpent Clan will live on.
chinese: 这些农民得学会自己的本分，也该给其他可能反抗的人做个榜样。只要杀光他们，并在这场交战中活下来，灵蛇族就能延续下去。
note: 与 WOTW 对应条目英文原文完全相同，复用逐条审阅的译文。

english: Shinja was always a little too headstrong for his own good. If I tear down his keep and I survive, surely he'll come to his senses and join me.
chinese: 信蛇一向倔得对自己都没好处。只要拆了他的要塞，而我还能活下来，他一定会清醒过来，加入我。

chinese: 好将领总会给自己留条退路，信蛇无疑是个好将领。幸好我们已把他逼入绝境。只要拆掉他的要塞，在战斗中击败他，而我最后也活着，他就别无选择，只能加入我……或者死。

english: Poor Otomo, fighting his never-ending battle for what is "right." Well, that ends today - if we defeat all of his hired mercenaries and confront him, surely he'll join me and help rebuild the Serpent empire. Slaughtering these weaklings should be amusing, but I mustn't get get carried away and lose my life.
chinese: 可怜的 Otomo，永远在为他所谓的“正义”而战。今天就让这一切结束吧——只要击败他雇来的所有佣兵，与他当面对质，他一定会加入我，协助重建灵蛇帝国。屠杀这些弱者想必很有趣，但我不能太得意忘形，把命也丢了。
note: 与 WOTW 对应条目英文原文完全相同，复用逐条审阅的译文。 人名依术语基线暂保留英文。

english: Shinja has nowhere to run - if we defeat him, surely he'll come to his senses and service the Serpent Clan once again. Shinja and Otomo have always fought, so I'll have to stay alive to keep them in their places.
chinese: 信蛇已无路可逃——只要击败他，他一定会清醒过来，重新效忠灵蛇族。信蛇和 Otomo 一直不和，所以我必须活着，才能管住他们。
status: 已确认专名离线修订，待实机验证
note: 与 WOTW 对应条目英文原文完全相同，复用逐条审阅的译文。 人名依术语基线暂保留英文。 | 2026-10-11 确认健治/信蛇

english: I used to respect the Wolf Clan, but now they're starting to annoy me. If we destroy their town and kill all of them, they should think twice before interfering with the Serpent Clan again. It's imperative that I stay alive if we're to reclaim the Orb from the Geisha.
chinese: 我过去尊敬恶狼族，可如今他们越来越让我厌烦。只要摧毁他们的城镇，杀光他们，他们下次干涉灵蛇族之前就该三思了。若要从艺妓手中夺回宝珠，我必须活下来。
note: 与 WOTW 对应条目英文原文完全相同，复用逐条审阅的译文。

english: There are two towns here just waiting to submit. I expect a scuffle with the Wolf Clan, but a display of power is the only way we'll win this province over. I need to survive if we're to get anywhere with the Swan's Pool Geisha.
chinese: 这里有两座城镇，正等着向我们臣服。我预计会与恶狼族发生冲突，但只有展示实力，才能赢得本省。我得活下来，才有机会从天鹅池的艺妓那里取得宝珠。
note: 与 WOTW 对应条目英文原文完全相同，复用逐条审阅的译文。

english: It's time Garrin's "sense of justice" got the better of him. If we crush his town and kill him, that should be just the kind of example we need to sway this province to our side.
chinese: 该让 Garrin 的“正义感”害了他自己了。摧毁他的城镇，杀死他，正好可以杀鸡儆猴，让本省归附我们。
note: 与 WOTW 对应条目英文原文完全相同，复用逐条审阅的译文。 人名依术语基线暂保留英文。

english: I'm not sure why Father trusted the Lotus, but we're all paying for it now. If we kill them and crush all of their buildings we can move on. The Geisha won't trust Shinja or Otomo, so I'll have to survive this encounter if we're to gain their support.
chinese: 我不明白父亲为何信任莲花族，如今我们都在为此付出代价。杀光他们，夷平所有建筑，我们就能继续前进。艺妓不会信任信蛇或 Otomo，所以若要争取她们的支持，我必须在这场战斗中活下来。
status: 已确认专名离线修订，待实机验证
note: 与 WOTW 对应条目英文原文完全相同，复用逐条审阅的译文。 人名依术语基线暂保留英文。 | 2026-10-11 确认健治/信蛇

english: The Swan's Pool Geisha need protection yet again - if we're to get the Orb from them, we'll need to protect them from the Lotus onslaught and earn their trust.
chinese: 天鹅池的艺妓又需要保护了——若要从她们手中取得宝珠，就必须挡住莲花族的进攻，赢得她们信任。
note: 与 WOTW 对应条目英文原文完全相同，复用逐条审阅的译文。

english: These flea-bitten miners make such terrible use of their freedom. If we destroy their towns and kill the rabble, surely they'll take note of the Serpent's power.
chinese: 这些满身跳蚤的矿工，把自由糟蹋得一塌糊涂。摧毁他们的城镇，杀光那些乌合之众，他们就该知道灵蛇族有多强大了。
note: 与 WOTW 对应条目英文原文完全相同，复用逐条审阅的译文。

english: The Lotus and their feeble tricks sicken me - kill them all and raze their towns and we can move on to Serpentholm.
chinese: 莲花族那些软弱的伎俩令我作呕——杀光他们，夷平城镇，我们就能继续前往灵蛇城。
note: 与 WOTW 对应条目英文原文完全相同，复用逐条审阅的译文。 Serpentholm 暂译灵蛇城。

english: I can't remember a more glorious battle on these hallowed grounds - kill, raze and maim all that stand in our way and the seat of Serpent power will be secured once again!
chinese: 我不记得这片圣地有过比这更辉煌的战役——杀戮、焚毁、重创一切挡路者，灵蛇族的权力中心将再次稳固！
note: 与 WOTW 对应条目英文原文完全相同，复用逐条审阅的译文。

english: The Wolf Clan have moved to the forefront of our battle. We must decimate their forces and towns and reclaim this province as our own. We can now build a Keep to house our Zen Masters, so the clan can press on if I am injured.
chinese: 恶狼族已成为这场战争的主要敌人。我们必须重创他们的部队和城镇，把本省夺回来。现在我们能建造要塞供禅师驻守，即使我负伤，氏族也能继续前进。
note: 与 WOTW 对应条目英文原文完全相同，复用逐条审阅的译文。

english: This farce has gone on long enough. If we destroy their three shale mines and their place of magic, the Cairn, we can break the back of the Wolf Clan resistance. We can now build a Keep to house our Zen Masters, so the clan can press on if I am injured.
chinese: 这场闹剧该结束了。只要摧毁他们的三座页岩矿井，以及那座施法之所——石冢，就能瓦解恶狼族的抵抗。现在我们能建造要塞供禅师驻守，即使我负伤，氏族也能继续前进。
note: 与 WOTW 对应条目英文原文完全相同，复用逐条审阅的译文。

english: The Lotus's original treachery took place in this decrepit province, and it will be their final resting place - leave no man or building standing! We can now build a Keep to house our Zen Masters, so the clan can press on if I am injured.
chinese: 莲花族最初的背叛就发生在这个破败省份，这里也将成为他们最后的葬身之地——一个人、一座建筑都不要留下！现在我们能建造要塞供禅师驻守，即使我负伤，氏族也能继续前进。
note: 与 WOTW 对应条目英文原文完全相同，复用逐条审阅的译文。

english: I'm not the superstitious type, but something is wrong here. This area was said to be home to a benevolent Dragon, but something...darker is here now. My gaze is continually drawn to the top of the spire, and I believe I'll find some answers there. I must survive.
chinese: 我不是迷信的人，但这里有些不对劲。据说这一带曾有一条仁慈的龙，如今却出现了某种……更黑暗的东西。我的目光总不由自主地投向尖塔顶端，我相信答案就在那里。我必须活下来。
note: 与 WOTW 对应条目英文原文完全相同，复用逐条审阅的译文。

english: This Necromancer will be a powerful ally, indeed - enemies that die in his presence are immediately recruited to our service as undead warriors. We have no peasants to build a town, but the Necromancer's powers should suffice to wipe out Otomo's pitiful rebels.
chinese: 这名死灵法师将是一位强大的盟友——在他身边死去的敌人会立刻变成亡灵战士，为我们效力。我们没有农民建造城镇，但凭他的力量，应该足以消灭 Otomo 那群可怜的叛军。
note: 与 WOTW 对应条目英文原文完全相同，复用逐条审阅的译文。 Necromancer 沿用术语基线死灵法师。 人名依术语基线暂保留英文。

english: The traitor Otomo must die, as must his pathetic Wolf allies. Otomo is nowhere to be seen now, but he is sure to emerge if we slay enough of his friends.
chinese: 叛徒 Otomo 必须死，他那些可悲的恶狼族盟友也一样。现在还看不到 Otomo，但只要杀够他的朋友，他一定会现身。
note: 与 WOTW 对应条目英文原文完全相同，复用逐条审阅的译文。 人名依术语基线暂保留英文。

english: So the Wolf want to enlist the Ninja's aid, do they? If we protect the Soul Flame from the Wolf the Ninja should join us instead. Or...we could probably catch the Ninja unprepared and destroy the Soul Flame first...
chinese: 恶狼族想争取忍者相助，是吗？只要保护魂火，不让恶狼族毁掉它，忍者应该会转而加入我们。或者……我们也许能趁忍者没有防备，先摧毁魂火……
note: 与 WOTW 对应条目英文原文完全相同，复用逐条审阅的译文。

english: With the Ninja on our side, it's time we eradicated the remaining Wolf forces.
chinese: 忍者已站到我们这边，现在该消灭恶狼族剩下的部队了。
note: 与 WOTW 对应条目英文原文完全相同，复用逐条审阅的译文。

english: These petulant Monks just don't know when to stop. If we demolish their precious monastery, we should have no trouble crushing their spirits and "convincing" them to join our cause. We can't build a town, but our starting forces should be adequate.
chinese: 这些任性的僧侣真是不知适可而止。只要拆掉他们珍爱的寺院，打垮他们的斗志，“说服”他们加入我们就不难了。我们无法建造城镇，但初始兵力应该足够。
note: 与 WOTW 对应条目英文原文完全相同，复用逐条审阅的译文。

english: This one province stands between me and Grayback. Liquidate the Wolf forces here and we'll be on our way.
chinese: 只剩这一个省份挡在我与 Grayback 之间。清除这里的恶狼族部队，我们就能继续上路。
note: 与 WOTW 对应条目英文原文完全相同，复用逐条审阅的译文。 人名依术语基线暂保留英文。

english: The rebel Grayback is breathing his last breaths. Attacking his forces should draw him from the Keep. If we kill him the pathetic Wolf Clan will dissolve and we can recover the Serpent's Orb at long last.
chinese: 叛军 Grayback 已是强弩之末。攻击他的部队，应该能把他从要塞引出来。只要杀了他，可悲的恶狼族便会瓦解，我们终于能夺回巨蛇宝珠。
note: 与 WOTW 对应条目英文原文完全相同，复用逐条审阅的译文。 人名依术语基线暂保留英文。

english: If we fight this abominable swarm of Hordelings their leader is sure to appear. Once this "Nightvol" reveals itself, we must kill it to complete our subjugation of this land.
chinese: 只要与这群可憎的 Hordelings 交战，他们的首领一定会出现。等那个“Nightvol”现身，我们必须杀死它，才能完成对这片土地的征服。
note: 与 WOTW 对应条目英文原文完全相同，复用逐条审阅的译文。 Hordelings 与 Nightvol 均暂留英文，需统一专名。 人名依术语基线暂保留英文。

note: 第五批：主线地图说明；地名暂按上下文译，待游戏内校对

english: Confront the mercenary Ninja and obtain their services before attacking the Lotus.
chinese: 先与雇佣忍者交涉并获得他们的效力，再进攻莲花族。
note: UI/message draft; exact source key

english: Reestablish contact with the Monks and enlist their aid to defeat the Lotus menace.
chinese: 重新联系僧侣，争取他们的协助，击败莲花族的威胁。
note: UI/message draft; exact source key

english: Attack Shinja's Keep to wrest this province from his grip and place it in your own.
chinese: 进攻信蛇的要塞，从他手中夺取这片行省。
status: 已确认专名离线修订，待实机验证
note: UI/message draft; exact source key | 2026-10-11 确认健治/信蛇

english: Defeat Otomo's hired archers and raze the village to claim the province for your own.
chinese: 击败 Otomo 雇用的弓箭手，夷平村庄，夺取这片行省。
note: UI/message draft; exact source key

english: Crush the Wolf Clan forces that have taken residence in this province.
chinese: 消灭盘踞在这片行省的恶狼族部队。
note: UI/message draft; exact source key；保留原文边缘空格供拼接。

english: A mercenary trade town that services both the Wolf and Lotus. This is the most direct route, but perhaps the most difficult.
chinese: 这座雇佣兵贸易城镇同时服务恶狼族与莲花族。这里是最直接的路线，也可能是最难走的一条。
note: Narrative draft; names retained in English; paired quote attribution remains separate

english: Lotus Warlocks have enslaved the locals, but the cover of forest should help us obliterate them and reclaim the peasants.
chinese: 莲花族术士奴役了当地人。借助森林掩护，我们应该能消灭他们，救回农民。
note: Narrative draft; names retained in English; paired quote attribution remains separate

english: Surprise the Wolf Clan from the side in this swampy province, weakening them on other fronts.
chinese: 从侧翼突袭这片沼泽行省里的恶狼族，削弱他们在其他战线的力量。
note: Narrative draft; names retained in English; paired quote attribution remains separate

english: Collapse the flea-ridden Wolf Clan’s shale mines to deprive them of materials for their armories.
chinese: 摧毁恶狼族那满是跳蚤的页岩矿井，切断其军械库的原料来源。
note: 第五批：主线地图说明；地名暂按上下文译，待游戏内校对

english: The last bastion of Lotus forces have retreated to this province. If we annihilate the Lotus Clan here we permanently scrub them from the political landscape.
chinese: 莲花族残部退守这片行省，这是他们最后的据点。若在此歼灭莲花族，就能将他们彻底赶出这片土地的权力版图。
note: Narrative draft; names retained in English; paired quote attribution remains separate

english: The Serpent’s old friends, the Ninja, hide in these swamps. Obtain their services to help cleanse the land of the Wolf.
chinese: 灵蛇族的旧友忍者藏身于这些沼泽。争取他们的帮助，扫荡此地的恶狼族。
note: 第五批：主线地图说明；地名暂按上下文译，待游戏内校对

english: The Monks continue to resist the Serpent Clan, but would be valuable allies. Break their spirits and coerce them to help crush the Wolf Clan.
chinese: 僧侣仍在抵抗灵蛇族，但他们会是有价值的盟友。击垮他们的意志，迫使他们帮助我们消灭恶狼族。
note: Narrative draft; names retained in English; paired quote attribution remains separate

english: Dragon Warriors, Kabuki Warriors, and Samurai have more health.
chinese: 神龙武士、歌舞伎战士和武士的生命值提高。

english: Archers and Samurai deal more damage with their ranged attacks.
chinese: 弓箭手和武士的远程攻击伤害提高。

english: Powder Keg Cannoneers have more health.
chinese: 相扑炮手的生命值提高。

english: Chemists deal more damage in an increased radius.
chinese: 炼丹师的伤害提高，作用范围扩大。

english: Dragon Warriors, Kabuki Warriors, and Samurai deal more damage in melee combat.
chinese: 神龙武士、歌舞伎战士和武士的近战伤害提高。

english: Chemists and Powder Keg Cannoneers gain a longer range.
chinese: 炼丹师和相扑炮手的射程增加。

english: Geisha use less stamina when healing allies.
chinese: 艺妓治疗友军时消耗的体力减少。

english: Increases the natural healing rate of all soldiers.
chinese: 提高所有士兵的自然恢复速度。

english: Geisha take less damage from cutting and piercing weapons.
chinese: 艺妓受到的劈砍和穿刺伤害减少。
训练有素的马生命值提高。

english: Trained horses use less stamina when running.
chinese: 训练有素的马奔跑时消耗的体力减少。

english: Dragon clan soldiers cannot be dismounted unless the horse dies.
chinese: 神龙族士兵只有在坐骑死亡时才会被击落马下。
note: 按用户四族定名及菜单术语统一

english: Swordsmen, Bandits, and Raiders gain more health.
chinese: 长剑客、匪徒和偷袭者的生命值提高。
偷袭者能把火把投得更远。

note: Vital Points 可指身体要害，暂用短名。

chinese: 火枪兵的射击伤害提高。

english: Crossbowmen and Cannoneers gain a longer range.
chinese: 十字弓手和火炮兵的射程增加。

english: Cannoneers can now carry two extra charges of Smoke Bombs.
chinese: 火炮兵现在可以额外携带两枚烟雾弹。
偷袭者的火把造成更多伤害。

english: Bandits' and Ronin weapons become poisonous.
chinese: 匪徒和浪人的武器附带毒性。

note: Plating 可能为马具护板，待图像核验。

english: Musketeers and Ronin take less damage from blunt and piercing weapons.
chinese: 火枪兵和浪人受到的钝击和穿刺伤害减少。

english: Fan Geisha use less stamina to heal allies.
chinese: 扇舞艺妓治疗友军时消耗的体力减少。
扇舞艺妓的生命值提高。
扇舞艺妓造成更多伤害。

english: Trained horses' movement speed is increased.
chinese: 训练有素的马移动速度提高。

note: Hobbling 的具体机制待核验。

chinese: 农民捕捉马匹的速度提高。

english: Trained horses' trample attacks use less stamina.
chinese: 训练有素的马发动践踏攻击时消耗的体力减少。
刀锋侍从造成更多伤害。

english: Unclean, Diseased, and Infested have more health.
chinese: 污秽者、恶疾者和感染者的生命值提高。

english: Diseased and Infested do more damage.
chinese: 恶疾者和感染者造成更多伤害。
叶刃信徒造成更多伤害。
note: 已确认术语：Leaf Disciple→叶刃信徒

english: Diseased, Infested, and Unclean can run further.
chinese: 恶疾者、感染者和污秽者能跑得更远。

english: The Infested and Diseased Ones' attacks have a greater area of effect.
chinese: 感染者和恶疾者攻击的作用范围扩大。

english: Staff Adepts, Acolytes and Leaf Disciples have more health.
chinese: 法杖师、刀锋侍从和叶刃信徒的生命值提高。
note: 已确认术语：Leaf Disciple→叶刃信徒

english: The Unclean One's attack is more powerful.
chinese: 污秽者的攻击威力提高。

english: The Channeler's ravens do more damage when attacking.
chinese: Channeler 的乌鸦造成的伤害提高。
note: Channeler 依术语基线暂留英文。

chinese: 缩短 Channeler 的训练时间。
note: Channeler 按术语基线暂留英文。

chinese: Channeler 恢复乌鸦的速度提高。
note: Channeler 按术语基线暂留英文。

chinese: 暗影坐骑造成更多伤害。
暗影坐骑的生命值提高。

english: The Shadow Steed's Infernal Breath uses less stamina.
chinese: 暗影坐骑的炼狱吐息消耗的体力减少。

english: Brawlers and Hurlers can run further.
chinese: 蛮横者和投石手能跑得更远。

english: Reduces the Combat Pit's training cost and speed.
chinese: 降低格斗场的训练费用和训练时间。
note: 原文 speed 语义按训练耗时处理，待游戏核验。

english: Maulers and Sledgers gain more health.
chinese: 槌头工和击石工的生命值提高。

english: Maulers and Pitch Slingers take less damage from explosives.
chinese: 槌头工和沥青投掷手受到的爆炸伤害减少。

english: Hurlers, Pitch Slingers, and Ballistamen have a longer range.
chinese: 投石手、沥青投掷手和巨弩手的射程增加。

english: Hurlers, Pitch Slingers, and Ballistamen do more damage from higher ground.
chinese: 投石手、沥青投掷手和巨弩手从高处攻击时造成更多伤害。

english: Brawlers and Hurlers are less likely to be hit by projectiles.
chinese: 蛮横者和投石手更不容易被投射物击中。

english: Druidesses receive two additional Blessing charges from the Cairn.
chinese: 女祭师从石冢获得两次额外的祝福使用次数。

english: Increases the rate of natural healing.

chinese: 女祭师的缠绕技能射程增加。

english: Pack Masters, Pack Wolves and Berserkers do more damage.
chinese: 驯狼师、驯狼和狂暴战士造成的伤害提高。

english: Stuns a single target at the cost of stamina.
chinese: 消耗体力，使单个目标眩晕。

english: All adjacent attackers are magically damaged at the cost of stamina.
chinese: 消耗体力，对所有相邻攻击者造成魔法伤害。

english: See enemies at a distance; immobilizes Archer and continually drains stamina.
chinese: 看见远处的敌人；弓箭手无法移动，并持续消耗体力。

english: Sets archer's arrows on fire; effective against buildings.
chinese: 点燃弓箭手的箭矢；对建筑有效。

note: 原文末尾含一个空格，中文末尾保留一个空格。

english: Poisons all adjacent enemies and reduces their damage by half for a short time; limit one.
chinese: 使所有相邻敌人中毒，并在短时间内将其伤害减半；限用一次。

english: Cascading rockets deal exposive damage to a large area; effective against buildings.
chinese: 连发火箭对大片区域造成爆炸伤害；对建筑有效。

english: Increases health regeneration, provides immunity to all damage and negative effects but immobilizes the unit. Costs stamina to activate and drains stamina to maintain shield power.
chinese: 提高生命恢复速度，免疫所有伤害和负面效果，但单位无法移动。启动时消耗体力，维持护盾时持续消耗体力。

english: Sword burns with fire to effectively damage buildings. Costs stamina per hit.
chinese: 剑刃燃火，可有效破坏建筑。每次命中消耗体力。

english: Casts a magic cloud on the ground. All units that enter it will not be able to use missile weapons; Sustainable, immobilizes the unit, drains stamina.
chinese: 在地面施放魔法云雾。进入云雾的单位无法使用远程武器；施法者无法移动，维持时持续消耗体力。
note: 原文 Sustainable 语义不明确，按持续维持处理，待游戏核验。

english: Blinds nearby enemies with incandescent powder and weakens their armor; limit two.
chinese: 用炽热粉末致盲附近敌人并削弱其护甲；限用两次。

english: Increases attack range, but reduces line of sight; costs stamina per shot.
chinese: 增加攻击射程，但缩小视野；每次射击消耗体力。

english: Explosion pierces units in a large area with sharp flechettes; limit one.
chinese: 爆炸以尖锐飞镖穿透大片区域内的单位；限用一次。

english: Attacks generate Yang, with damage increasing as Yang does; costs stamina per hit.
chinese: 攻击产生阳，且阳越多，伤害越高；每次命中消耗体力。

english: The Samurai takes no damage from missile weapons or enemy magic; continually drains stamina.
chinese: 武士免疫远程武器和敌方魔法伤害；持续消耗体力。

english: Surrenders the Geisha's life to completely heal nearby allies.
chinese: 牺牲艺妓的生命，完全治愈附近友军。

english: Grants a bit of protection against all attacks (except magic), damages enemies with explosives during melee combat; continually drains stamina.
chinese: 略微抵御除魔法外的所有攻击，并在近战中以爆炸伤害攻击敌人；持续消耗体力。

english: Adds range to Musketeer's shots and prevents him from running. Costs stamina to activate.
chinese: 增加火枪兵的射程，但使其无法奔跑。启动时消耗体力。

english: Fires explosive, area-effect projectiles; effective against buildings.
chinese: 发射造成范围爆炸伤害的投射物；对建筑有效。

english: Pilfers all non-hero enemy Battle Gear from all nearby enemies but does no damage. Gives the clan a percentage of the pilfered Battle Gear's cost.
chinese: 窃取附近所有非英雄敌人的技能，但不造成伤害。本族获得相当于所窃技能费用一定比例的资源。
status: 显示反馈离线修订，待实机验证
note: 原文未说明收益资源类别，译文不增补。 | 2026-10-11 显示反馈；按源字段修订

english: A powerful one-time attack that instantly kills a single non-hero opponent but damages the user.
chinese: 一次强力攻击，可立即杀死单个非英雄敌人，但会伤及使用者。

english: Weakens enemy armor, making them take more damage from all attacks.
chinese: 削弱敌方护甲，使其承受的所有攻击伤害增加。

english: Reveals line of sight where it lands; up to nine may be active at a time.
chinese: 在落点提供视野；同时最多可存在九个。

english: Burns any rice or trees near the Raider at the cost of stamina.
chinese: 消耗体力，焚烧偷袭者附近的稻米或树木。

english: The Raider drops sharp spikes behind him as he runs; limit 10 per unit, 30 per team.
chinese: 偷袭者奔跑时在身后撒下尖刺；每个单位最多10处，每队最多30处。
note: 机械数值沿用原文阿拉伯数字。

english: Move about invisibly; broken by attacks or attacking; continually drains stamina.
chinese: 隐身移动；受到攻击或发动攻击时隐身解除；持续消耗体力。

english: Toxin-tipped crossbow darts stun and poison enemies; limit four per Bandit.
chinese: 涂毒弩箭使敌人眩晕并中毒；每名匪徒限用四次。

english: Casts a smoke cloud on the ground that temporarily blinds enemies that enter it reducing their damage.
chinese: 在地面施放烟雾，使进入其中的敌人暂时失明，并降低其伤害。

english: Plant an explosive that activates when enemies get near. Unit can carry 3, and up to 20 per team can be active.
chinese: 安放敌人靠近时引爆的炸药。单位可携带3枚，每队同时最多可布置20枚。
note: 机械数值沿用原文阿拉伯数字。

english: Bond with an allied soldier and he will take half of incoming damage.
chinese: 与一名友军士兵结成羁绊，由他承受所受伤害的一半。
note: Blood Bond 效果描述中的伤害承担方向待游戏核验。

english: Damage from magical blades drains enemy stamina to create Yin; costs stamina per hit.
chinese: 魔法刀刃造成伤害时吸取敌方体力并产生阴；每次命中消耗体力。

english: Fan Geisha and nearby allies give up a portion of their total health to gain an equal portion of damage resistance; Costs stamina.
chinese: 扇舞艺妓和附近友军牺牲一部分生命值，获得等量的伤害抗性；消耗体力。

english: Nearby allies gain health with each attack; drains stamina with each attack. Fan Geisha will not heal when this ability is toggled on.
chinese: 附近友军每次攻击都会恢复生命，每次攻击消耗体力。启用此能力时，扇舞艺妓不会治疗。

note: Draft translated from current Zen Edition source. Exact same English in matched tooltip context.

english: Flings leaves in all directions to see distant enemies at the cost of stamina.
chinese: 消耗体力，向四面八方撒出树叶，发现远处的敌人。

note: Draft translated from current Zen Edition source. Exact same English in matched tooltip context.

english: Prevents damage by projectiles to nearby allies and the Adept, but immobilizes him.
chinese: 使法杖师和附近友军免受投射物伤害，但法杖师无法移动。

note: Draft translated from current Zen Edition source. Exact same English in matched tooltip context.

english: Sprays vomit on the ground, all units stepping in it will take more damage.
chinese: 在地面喷吐污物；踏入其中的单位受到的伤害增加。

note: Draft translated from current Zen Edition source. Exact same English in matched tooltip context.

english: Terrifying screech dismounts nearby riders and drains enemy stamina; Costs stamina.
chinese: 消耗体力，发出骇人的尖啸，使附近骑兵落马，并削减敌人的体力。

note: Draft translated from current Zen Edition source. Exact same English in matched tooltip context.

english: Creates a pool of tar, slowing enemies' movement speed and making them more flammable at the cost of stamina.
chinese: 消耗体力，制造一片沥青，降低敌人的移动速度并使其更容易着火。

note: Draft translated from current Zen Edition source. Exact same English in matched tooltip context.

english: Creates a magical screaming skull to serve as a watcher and attacker; only one may be active at a time.
chinese: 制造一个会尖叫的魔法骷髅头，用于警戒和攻击；同时只能存在一个。

note: Draft translated from current Zen Edition source. Exact same English in matched tooltip context.

english: The Infested One releases a maggoty blight to destroy rice at the cost of stamina.
chinese: 感染者消耗体力，释放蛆虫灾害来毁坏稻米。

note: Draft translated from current Zen Edition source. Exact same English in matched tooltip context.

english: The Infested One automatically springs back to life when killed; can only be used once.
chinese: 感染者死亡时自动复活；只能使用一次。

note: Draft translated from current Zen Edition source. Exact same English in matched tooltip context.

english: Sturdy armor hewn from the hills offers protection against all incoming damage, especially against magic.
chinese: 从山岩中凿出的坚固护甲可抵御所有伤害，尤其能抵御魔法。

note: Draft translated from current Zen Edition source. Exact same English in matched tooltip context.

english: A one-time attack severely damages an enemy or instantly kills a Zen Master.
chinese: 一次性攻击，可重创敌人，或立即杀死一名禅师。

note: Draft translated from current Zen Edition source. Exact same English in matched tooltip context.

english: Thrown rocks now do area-effect explosive damage; effective against buildings. Costs stamina per attack.
chinese: 投掷的石块现在造成范围爆炸伤害；对建筑有效。每次攻击消耗体力。

note: Draft translated from current Zen Edition source. Exact same English in matched tooltip context.

english: The Mauler spins to damage all adjacent enemies; effective agaisnt buildings; continually drains stamina.
chinese: 槌头工旋转攻击所有相邻敌人；对建筑有效；持续消耗体力。

note: Draft translated from current Zen Edition source. Exact same English in matched tooltip context.

english: Fires a carved totem that slows nearby enemies and increases damage of Wolf units.
chinese: 发射雕刻过的图腾，减慢附近敌人的速度，并提高恶狼族单位的伤害。

note: Draft translated from current Zen Edition source. Exact same English in matched tooltip context.

english: Throw a sight-extending pitch mine to the targeted location; two per unit, limit of twelve per team.
chinese: 向目标位置投掷可扩大视野的沥青地雷；每个单位可放两个，每队最多十二个。

note: Draft translated from current Zen Edition source. Exact same English in matched tooltip context.

english: Strike the ground to stun nearby enemies at the cost of stamina.
chinese: 消耗体力，猛击地面，使附近敌人眩晕。

note: Draft translated from current Zen Edition source. Exact same English in matched tooltip context.

english: Call wolves from the Wolves' Den to your side.
chinese: 召唤狼穴中的狼来到身边。

note: Draft translated from current Zen Edition source. Exact same English in matched tooltip context.

english: Berserker transforms into a Werewolf; Werewolf has half health initially.
chinese: 狂暴战士变身为狼人；变身后的狼人起初只有一半生命值。

note: Draft translated from current Zen Edition source. Exact same English in matched tooltip context.

english: Next attack does critical damage at the cost of stamina. If the target dies it transforms into a wolf.
chinese: 消耗体力，使下一次攻击造成暴击伤害。如果目标死亡，便会变成一头狼。

note: Draft translated from current Zen Edition source. Exact same English in matched tooltip context.

english: Bestow new powers upon Wolf units; get more from the Cairn, starting limit of three charges.
chinese: 赋予恶狼族单位新的力量；从石冢获得更多使用次数，初始上限为三次。

chinese: 僧侣送来的“礼物”。忍者受害者的痛苦灵魂在这里燃烧，提醒他们自己的黑暗行径。

english: This ancient monastery has long been a tranquil bastion of peace despite the war around it.
chinese: 尽管战火环绕，这座古老寺院长久以来仍是宁静的避风港。

english: Stand Ground (Toggle) - Unit will hold position, attacking targets within their range. Unit will retain the order until it's toggled off or attack order is issued (does not apply to missile units).
chinese: 原地坚守（切换）：单位会守住位置，攻击射程内的目标。再次切换或下达攻击命令前，此命令持续有效（远程单位除外）。

english: Guard/Follow - Unit will guard an area, unit or building within a short radius. This can be used to guard/follow a specific unit.
chinese: 守卫／跟随：单位会在小范围内守卫一片区域、一个单位或一座建筑。也可用于守卫或跟随指定单位。
status: 显示反馈离线修订，待实机验证

english: Passive Mode (Toggle) - Unit will not attack, but will respond to melee engagement. Unit will retain the order until it's toggled off or attack order is issued.
chinese: 被动模式（切换）：单位不会主动攻击，但遭遇近战攻击时会还手。再次切换或下达攻击命令前，此命令持续有效。
status: 显示反馈离线修订，待实机验证

english: Force attack - Unit will not engage enemy units en route to Forced target.
chinese: 强制攻击：单位前往指定目标途中不会与敌方单位交战。
status: 显示反馈离线修订，待实机验证

english: Stop - Unit will momentarily stop performing any orders.
chinese: 停止：单位会暂时停止执行所有命令。
status: 显示反馈离线修订，待实机验证

english: Master of the Clan, Kenji is a fierce, inspiring warrior.
chinese: 健治是本族之主，也是一位勇猛而善于鼓舞人心的战士。

english: Special Abilities: Critical Strike and Inspiration
chinese: 特殊能力：致命一击、激励

english: Wise and honorable warrior, Otomo wields a massive nodachi effective both against units and buildings. His fighting abilities inspire allies in battle.
chinese: Otomo 睿智而正直，挥舞巨大的野太刀，对单位和建筑都很有效。他的战斗本领能鼓舞友军。

english: Special Abilities: Battle Cry and Battle Leader
chinese: 特殊能力：战吼、战场领袖

english: A tough Monk skilled with fire, Kazan burns buildings with ease.
chinese: Kazan 是精通火焰的强壮僧侣，能轻易焚毁建筑。

english: Special Abilities: Flame Breath and Fire Wielder
chinese: 特殊能力：火焰吐息、御火

english: A world-renowned archer, Arah's arrows fly with skill and strength.
chinese: Arah 是闻名天下的弓箭手，箭术娴熟，力道十足。

english: Special Abilities: Sight Beyond Sight and Deadly Accuracy
chinese: 特殊能力：超凡视野、精准致命

english: While a skilled fighter all-around, Garrin excels on horseback.
chinese: Garrin 是全面的战士，骑马作战尤其出色。

english: Special Abilities: Call Horse and Bracing
chinese: 特殊能力：召唤马匹、架势防御

english: Master of Balance, Tao is an able fighter and can enlist two additional Monks or Ninja.
chinese: Tao 精通平衡之道，身手不凡，还能招募两名额外的僧侣或忍者。

english: Special Abilities: Reversal of Fortune and Monastic Influence
chinese: 特殊能力：命运逆转、修行感召

english: A fearsome warrior, Shinja slays enemies with twin poisoned blades.
chinese: 信蛇是令人畏惧的战士，以两把淬毒刀刃斩杀敌人。
status: 已确认专名离线修订，待实机验证

english: Special Abilities: Intimidation and Ye of Little Faith
chinese: 特殊能力：威吓、信念薄弱者

english: A lumbering slave driver, Budo "encourages" peasants with sharp whip and tongue.
chinese: 武堂 是个身形笨重的奴隶监工，用利鞭和尖刻言辞“激励”农民。

english: Lithe geisha of the dark, Utara's beauty and voice spell doom for her enemy.
chinese: Utara 是一名身姿轻盈的黑暗艺妓，她的美貌与歌声会为敌人招来厄运。

english: Special Abilities: Song of Sorrow and Pleasure and Pain
chinese: 特殊能力：哀伤之歌、痛并快乐

english: A corrupt and athletic womanizer, both Vetkin and his sai are fast and deadly.
chinese: Vetkin 腐化堕落、身手敏捷又好色；他和手中的三叉短刃都快而致命。
note: Sai 暂译三叉短刃，待角色外观核验。

chinese: 特殊能力：虚张声势、疾跑

english: Master of the Lotus, Zymeth calls rain to his fields and lightning to his foes.
chinese: 莲花族之主 Zymeth 为田地唤来雨水，为敌人招来闪电。

english: Special Abilities: Heavy Rain and Storm Master
chinese: 特殊能力：暴雨、风暴大师

english: A scholar of time, Issyl hastens his allies with his dark magic.
chinese: Issyl 研习时间之术，以黑暗魔法加快友军的行动。

english: A scholar of space, Koril can teleport anywhere with ease.
chinese: Koril 研习空间之术，能轻易瞬移到任何地方。

english: A scholar of matter, Soban can build helpful Golems from stone and mud.
chinese: Soban 研习物质之术，能用泥土和石头造出有用的魔像。

english: Leader of the Wolf Clan, Grayback is a noble and resilient warrior.
chinese: 恶狼族领袖 Grayback 是一位高贵而坚韧的战士。

english: Special Abilities: Wolf Howl and Alpha Male
Armed with a bladed boomerang effective both against units and buildings, nimble Longtooth ravages enemies near and far alike.
chinese: Longtooth 身手敏捷，手持带刃回旋镖，对单位和建筑都很有效，远近敌人皆难逃其锋。

english: Special Abilities: Razor-Edged Boomerang and Climbing
chinese: 特殊能力：利刃回旋镖、攀爬

english: A beautiful forest nymph, Gaihla blesses both flora and fauna with nature's magic.
chinese: Gaihla 是美丽的森林仙女，以自然魔法祝福花草与动物。

english: Special Abilities: Chant of Life and Crop Blessing
chinese: 特殊能力：生命颂歌、作物祝福

english: An angry fusion of shale and man, the Shale Lord smashes buildings and armors allies.
chinese: 页岩领主是人与页岩愤怒融合的产物，能摧毁建筑并为友军披上护甲。

english: Special Abilities: Armored Friend and Battle Lust
chinese: 特殊能力：护甲援友、战斗狂热

chinese: 你处于观战模式，只能与其他观战者聊天。

english: Explosive-lined club stuns and damages the Guardian and nearby enemy units. Limited to one use.
chinese: 带爆药的棍棒使 Guardian 和附近敌方单位眩晕并受伤。限用一次。
note: Guardian 是 WOTW 新增单位，名称暂留英文待审。

english: Battle Maiden splits into two half-strength images at the cost of stamina. An effective escape tactic.
chinese: Battle Maiden 消耗体力，分裂出两个力量减半的幻影。这是有效的脱身手段。
note: Battle Maiden 是 WOTW 新增单位，名称暂留英文待审。

english: Protects Teppo from all harmful effects, such as blindness, stunning and weakness. Costs stamina.
chinese: 保护 Teppo 免受失明、眩晕和虚弱等一切有害效果；消耗体力。

english: Channels stamina to create a hideous Shambler from a nearby corpse to serve the Reaper. Limit one per Reaper.
chinese: 消耗体力，利用附近尸体制造一只丑陋的 Shambler，为 Reaper 效力。每名 Reaper 限有一只。
note: Shambler 和 Reaper 是 WOTW 新增单位，名称暂留英文待审。

english: Absorbs a targeted corpse to heal the Shambler.
chinese: 吸收一具指定尸体，治疗 Shambler。

english: Encases nearby enemy units in ice, preventing movement and slowly damaging them. Costs stamina.
chinese: 将附近敌方单位封入冰中，使其无法移动并持续受到伤害；消耗体力。

english: Deals great damage and stuns a target, can also dismount riders from horses. Costs stamina.
chinese: 重创并眩晕一个目标，也能使骑兵落马；消耗体力。

english: These tactical boots permanently boost Enforcer's movement speed, which also makes him evade ranged attacks.
chinese: 这双战术靴永久提高 Enforcer 的移动速度，也使其能躲避远程攻击。
note: Enforcer 是 WOTW 新增单位，名称暂留英文待审。

english: Transforms the Witch into a terrifying Demoness.
chinese: 将 Witch 变成可怕的 Demoness。
note: Witch、Demoness 是 WOTW 新增单位，名称暂留英文待审。

english: Sinister incantation greatly weakens enemy units against magical damage at the cost of stamina.
chinese: 消耗体力，以邪恶咒语大幅削弱敌方单位对魔法伤害的抵抗力。

english: Digger tunnels to a new location, where he remains invisible to the enemy until moved or stamina is depleted.
chinese: Digger 挖地道前往新位置；在移动或体力耗尽前，敌人无法看见它。
note: Digger 是 WOTW 新增单位，名称暂留英文待审。

english: Expends stamina to summon a powerful spirit wolf. Only three may be active at a time.
chinese: 消耗体力，召唤一只强大的幽灵狼。同时最多可存在三只。

english: Siphons tower energy to increase allies' armor. Drains stamina, and only usable near enemy towers.
chinese: 吸取敌方塔楼的能量，提高友军护甲。持续消耗体力，且只能在敌方塔楼附近使用。

english: Drains enemy tower energy to gradually heal the Witch's allies. Drains stamina, and only usable near enemy towers.
chinese: 吸取敌方塔楼的能量，逐渐治疗 Witch 的友军。持续消耗体力，且只能在敌方塔楼附近使用。

english: Channels enemy tower energy to damage enemies around, only usable near enemy towers.
chinese: 引导敌方塔楼的能量，伤害周围敌人；只能在敌方塔楼附近使用。

english: Osmoses enemy tower energy, strengthening the attack power of all nearby allies. Drains stamina, and only usable near enemy towers.
chinese: 汲取敌方塔楼的能量，增强附近所有友军的攻击力。持续消耗体力，且只能在敌方塔楼附近使用。

english: I hadn't yet decided what I would do once I had returned, but circumstances had conspired to force a choice upon me. Should I protect these helpless villagers by attacking the bandits or should I help the bandits keep these peasants in their place? No doubt my actions here will dictate the future of the land.
chinese: 我尚未决定归来后要做什么，可眼前的局势逼我作出选择。是攻击匪徒，保护这些无助的村民；还是帮助匪徒，让这些农民继续受他们压迫？毫无疑问，我在这里的举动将决定这片土地的未来。
note: 同源异译审校：keep these peasants in their place 的施压主体是匪徒；原译误归因于农民。

english: This is the beginning of something new...something good. I went against my upbringing and attacked the bandits to protect the peasants. I've started something here, and I must finish the job: I must kill all attacking bandits and save the village, and not lose my life doing so.
chinese: 这是一个崭新的开始……一个好的开始。我背弃了从小接受的教导，攻击匪徒，保护农民。既然已经迈出这一步，就必须把事做完：杀死所有来犯匪徒，拯救村庄，而且自己也得活下来。

english: Otomo was right - Shinja intends to put up a fight. If I destroy his Keep and confront him, he should listen to reason - I am the heir to the Serpent empire, after all. My new clan lacks leadership, though, and will certainly crumble if I were to die.
chinese: Otomo 说得对——信蛇打算抵抗。如果摧毁他的要塞，与他当面对质，他应该会听我讲道理——毕竟我是灵蛇帝国的继承人。不过我的新氏族缺少领袖；如果我死了，他们必然分崩离析。
status: 已确认专名离线修订，待实机验证

english: With Shinja's mercenaries out of the way, he has nowhere left to run. If we destroy his Keep to the North and defeat him, our hunt will end. He's still loyal to my family, so if I live through this battle he'll most certainly join us.
chinese: 信蛇的雇佣兵已被清除，他无处可逃了。只要摧毁北面的要塞并打败他，这场追捕就结束了。他仍忠于我的家族，只要我在此战中活下来，他一定会加入我们。
status: 已确认专名离线修订，待实机验证

english: Shinja's mercenaries again...this rabble should fall easily. If I kill them all, this province will join my cause. If I survive, the Clan will grow.
chinese: 又是信蛇的雇佣兵……这群乌合之众应该不难对付。杀光他们，本省便会归附我。只要我活下来，氏族就能壮大。
status: 已确认专名离线修订，待实机验证

english: Shinja has always had a talent for escape, but we've cornered him now - that snake doesn't have anywhere else to run. If we defeat him in battle, I can surely sway him to our cause. I must survive if we're to enlist his aid.
chinese: 信蛇一向擅长逃脱，但现在我们把他逼入了绝境——那条蛇再也无处可逃。只要在战斗中打败他，我一定能劝他加入我们。若要得到他的帮助，我必须活下来。
status: 已确认专名离线修订，待实机验证

english: The Wolf miners...I never thought I'd be fighting against them. As much as it pains me, we have no choice but to fight - we should clear them away and move on to the Swan's Pool. The Geisha trust me, so I must survive if we're to reclaim the Orb.
chinese: 那些恶狼族矿工……我从没想过会与他们交战。尽管心里难受，我们别无选择，只能击退他们，继续前往天鹅池。艺妓信任我；若要夺回宝珠，我就必须活下来。

english: The keys to claiming this province are the two villages. I expect some kind of encounter in the second, given the guard's warnings about the Lotus. A display of power will sway the people here, but I mustn't get careless and die if we're to reclaim the Orb from the Geisha.
chinese: 要拿下本省，关键是那两座村庄。卫兵警告过莲花族，我预计第二座村庄会遭遇些什么。展示实力就能赢得当地人，但若要从艺妓手中夺回宝珠，我可不能大意送命。

english: So, it would seem that this Vetkin is behind all of this...I hope Lord Garrin is all right. I've no idea why the noble Wolf Clan would side with Vetkin, but we must clear them away and move on to the Swan's Pool. The Geisha trust me, so it's imperative that I survive this encounter.
chinese: 这么看来，幕后主使是 Vetkin……希望 Garrin 大人平安无事。我不明白高贵的恶狼族为何会站到 Vetkin 一边，但我们必须击退他们，继续前往天鹅池。艺妓信任我，因此这一仗我务必活下来。

english: The Lotus...I've never trusted them, and it seems my suspicions were well-founded. If we're to free this province, we'll need to defeat the Master Warlock who controls the locals. The Geisha trust me, so I must be on my guard if we're to reclaim the Orb...
chinese: 莲花族……我从来不信任他们，如今看来我的怀疑没有错。若要解放本省，就必须击败控制当地人的 Master Warlock。艺妓信任我；若要夺回宝珠，我得时时警惕……
note: Master Warlock 尚无已定译名，暂留英文。

english: Our enemies have come for the Serpent's Orb - how did they know it was here? Regardless, we must protect the Geisha’s home at all costs if we're to earn their trust and claim the Orb.
chinese: 敌人是冲着巨蛇宝珠来的——他们怎么知道宝珠在这里？无论如何，若想赢得艺妓的信任并取得宝珠，就必须不惜一切代价守住她们的家园。

english: The Wolf Clan have changed much while I was away - they're certainly stronger than before. As much as it pains me, we must defeat them and hurry to Serpentholm - the Orb is in danger of falling into the wrong hands.
chinese: 我离开的这些年里，恶狼族变了许多——他们显然比过去更强大。尽管心里难受，我们还是必须击败他们，赶往灵蛇城；宝珠就要落入不该得到它的人手中了。
note: Serpentholm 暂译灵蛇城，待世界观专名统一。

english: The Lotus Clan has always had a problem with Serpent authority. The only way to protect my people is to completely wipe them out, leaving neither man nor mortar standing. I cannot fail - we're getting too close.
chinese: 莲花族一向不服灵蛇族的统治。若要保护我的人民，就只能将他们彻底消灭，不留下一个人、一座建筑。我不能失败——我们已经离目标很近了。

english: Many battles have been fought on these grounds, but none so fierce as this. As this will be the new seat of the Dragon Clan's republic, we must leave no trace of the opposition or we compromise the Clan's security forever.
chinese: 这片土地经历过无数战役，却没有哪一场如此激烈。这里将成为神龙族共和国的新都，必须扫除所有敌对势力，否则氏族的安全将永远受到威胁。

english: I've never understood Kenji's soft spot for the Wolf Clan - I suppose they're easier to like if you've been vacationing for the last seven years. If our new clan is to flourish, we must wipe out the Wolf Clan and leave none of their hovels standing. We can now build a Keep to house our Zen Masters, so protecting our leaders is no longer crucial to victory.
chinese: 我从来不懂健治为何对恶狼族心软——也许离家度假七年后，他们看着更讨人喜欢吧。若要让我们的新氏族兴盛，就必须消灭恶狼族，连他们的破棚屋都不留。现在我们能建造要塞供禅师驻守，因此保护领袖不再是取胜的必要条件。
status: 已确认专名离线修订，待实机验证

english: You can take the Wolf out of the mines, but I guess you can't take the mines out of the Wolf. There are three mines here and we should destroy all of them. They've also built a Cairn at some "nexus" to the East, which will also need to fall. We can now build a Keep to house our Zen Masters, so protecting our leaders is no longer critical.
chinese: 你可以把狼从矿井里带出来，却没法把矿井从狼心里赶出去。这里有三座矿井，我们应当全部摧毁。他们还在东边某个所谓的“汇点”建了一座石冢，也得拆掉。现在我们能建造要塞供禅师驻守，因此保护领袖不再至关重要。

english: The Lotus are shaping up to be quite the adversary. I'm sure that even Kenji would agree that they all must be taught a lesson - we'll wipe out all of their people and buildings and move on. We can now build a Keep to house our Zen Masters, so protecting our leaders is no longer essential.
chinese: 莲花族正成为相当棘手的对手。我敢说，就连健治也会同意给他们一个教训——消灭他们所有人和建筑，再继续前进。现在我们能建造要塞供禅师驻守，因此保护领袖不再是必需的。
status: 已确认专名离线修订，待实机验证

english: I never remembered this province being so desolate. I know we're getting close, and it's not because of the smell of burning flesh. The Dragon is here, waiting for me at the spire...I just know it. I must meet with him - perhaps his power is the key to ending this war.
chinese: 我记忆中的这个省份从未如此荒凉。我知道我们已经接近目标，但这不是因为烧焦血肉的气味。龙就在这里，在尖塔等着我……我确信如此。我必须见到他——也许他的力量正是结束这场战争的关键。
note: 同源异译审校：not because 是否定气味为依据，原译“不只是因为”改变了逻辑。

english: The Dragon has issued a challenge - I must brave the gauntlet of the Dragon's Spire and meet it at the mountain's summit. This trial is sure to be difficult, but if I survive I'll have the Dragon's favor.
chinese: 龙向我发出了挑战——我必须闯过龙之尖塔的重重考验，在山顶与它相见。试炼肯定艰险，但只要活下来，我便能得到龙的眷顾。

english: Betrayed! I should have seen this coming. There's a village to the East which can provide us with supplies and a work force. If we gain their support we should have no problem wiping out the Lotus and returning to Serpentholm and punishing those responsible.
chinese: 遭到背叛！我早该料到的。东面有座村庄，能为我们提供补给和人手。只要赢得他们的支持，我们就能扫平莲花族，返回灵蛇城，惩罚那些幕后元凶。
note: Serpentholm 暂译灵蛇城，待世界观专名统一。

english: The traitor Shinja must be defeated! He's resurrected the old Serpent guard, built himself a fine Keep and allied himself with the Lotus - all must fall. Shinja will pay for what he did to you, Otomo!
chinese: 必须打败叛徒信蛇！他重建了旧灵蛇卫队，修起一座像样的要塞，还与莲花族结盟——这些都必须摧毁。Otomo，信蛇要为他对你做的一切付出代价！
status: 已确认专名离线修订，待实机验证

english: The Ninja are bound by the mysterious Soul Flame...if we destroy its pedestal to extinguish the flame, they'll be bound to us. We're not prepared to build a town here, so we must use our forces carefully.
chinese: 忍者受到神秘魂火的束缚……只要摧毁底座、熄灭火焰，他们就会受我们驱使。我们无法在这里建造城镇，因此必须谨慎运用现有兵力。

english: The Lotus have allied with the Ninja and would prevent me from allying with the Monks. If we destroy the Lotus outpost and weather the Ninja's attacks we will be victorious, provided that the Monastery is still standing.
chinese: 莲花族与忍者结盟，阻止我争取僧侣。只要摧毁莲花族的前哨，抵御忍者的进攻，并确保寺院仍然屹立，我们就能获胜。

english: This is the last province before we arrive on the Lotus home plateau. Obliterating the Lotus here is the only option.
chinese: 这是抵达莲花族故乡高原前的最后一个省份。除了在这里消灭莲花族，我们别无选择。

english: Zymeth is using the orb, no doubt - if we besiege his forces he should show himself. Once we kill Zymeth, this should all be over...
chinese: Zymeth 毫无疑问正在使用宝珠——只要围攻他的军队，他应该就会现身。杀死 Zymeth，一切就该结束了……

english: The Horde, the Dragon Clan's legendary foe, still lives and comes to infest our land. If we survive their attacks long enough it should draw out their leader, this "Nightvol." Killing that monster is our goal.
chinese: 神龙族传说中的宿敌——大群——仍然存在，如今又来侵扰我们的土地。只要我们撑过足够久的进攻，他们的首领，那个叫“Nightvol”的家伙应该就会现身。杀死那个怪物就是我们的目标。
note: Horde 暂译大群；Nightvol 保留英文，待专名核验。

english: These Peasants need to learn their place and serve as an example to others that might rebel. If I kill them all and survive the encounter, the Serpent Clan will live on.
chinese: 这些农民得学会自己的本分，也该给其他可能反抗的人做个榜样。只要杀光他们，并在这场交战中活下来，灵蛇族就能延续下去。

english: Shinja was always a little too headstrong for his own good. If I tear down his keep and I survive, surely he'll come to his senses and join me.
chinese: 信蛇一向倔得对自己都没好处。只要拆了他的要塞，而我还能活下来，他一定会清醒过来，加入我。
status: 已确认专名离线修订，待实机验证

english: A good general always has an escape route ready, and Shinja is certainly a good general. Fortunately, we've cornered him here. If we tear down his keep, defeat him in combat and I'm alive after it all, he'll have no choice but to join me...or die.
chinese: 好将领总会给自己留条退路，信蛇无疑是个好将领。幸好我们已把他逼入绝境。只要拆掉他的要塞，在战斗中击败他，而我最后也活着，他就别无选择，只能加入我……或者死。
status: 已确认专名离线修订，待实机验证

english: Poor Otomo, fighting his never-ending battle for what is "right." Well, that ends today - if we defeat all of his hired mercenaries and confront him, surely he'll join me and help rebuild the Serpent empire. Slaughtering these weaklings should be amusing, but I mustn't get get carried away and lose my life.
chinese: 可怜的 Otomo，永远在为他所谓的“正义”而战。今天就让这一切结束吧——只要击败他雇来的所有佣兵，与他当面对质，他一定会加入我，协助重建灵蛇帝国。屠杀这些弱者想必很有趣，但我不能太得意忘形，把命也丢了。

english: Shinja has nowhere to run - if we defeat him, surely he'll come to his senses and service the Serpent Clan once again. Shinja and Otomo have always fought, so I'll have to stay alive to keep them in their places.
chinese: 信蛇已无路可逃——只要击败他，他一定会清醒过来，重新效忠灵蛇族。信蛇和 Otomo 一直不和，所以我必须活着，才能管住他们。
status: 已确认专名离线修订，待实机验证

english: I used to respect the Wolf Clan, but now they're starting to annoy me. If we destroy their town and kill all of them, they should think twice before interfering with the Serpent Clan again. It's imperative that I stay alive if we're to reclaim the Orb from the Geisha.
chinese: 我过去尊敬恶狼族，可如今他们越来越让我厌烦。只要摧毁他们的城镇，杀光他们，他们下次干涉灵蛇族之前就该三思了。若要从艺妓手中夺回宝珠，我必须活下来。

english: There are two towns here just waiting to submit. I expect a scuffle with the Wolf Clan, but a display of power is the only way we'll win this province over. I need to survive if we're to get anywhere with the Swan's Pool Geisha.
chinese: 这里有两座城镇，正等着向我们臣服。我预计会与恶狼族发生冲突，但只有展示实力，才能赢得本省。我得活下来，才有机会从天鹅池的艺妓那里取得宝珠。

english: It's time Garrin's "sense of justice" got the better of him. If we crush his town and kill him, that should be just the kind of example we need to sway this province to our side.
chinese: 该让 Garrin 的“正义感”害了他自己了。摧毁他的城镇，杀死他，正好可以杀鸡儆猴，让本省归附我们。

english: I'm not sure why Father trusted the Lotus, but we're all paying for it now. If we kill them and crush all of their buildings we can move on. The Geisha won't trust Shinja or Otomo, so I'll have to survive this encounter if we're to gain their support.
chinese: 我不明白父亲为何信任莲花族，如今我们都在为此付出代价。杀光他们，夷平所有建筑，我们就能继续前进。艺妓不会信任信蛇或 Otomo，所以若要争取她们的支持，我必须在这场战斗中活下来。
status: 已确认专名离线修订，待实机验证

english: The Swan's Pool Geisha need protection yet again - if we're to get the Orb from them, we'll need to protect them from the Lotus onslaught and earn their trust.
chinese: 天鹅池的艺妓又需要保护了——若要从她们手中取得宝珠，就必须挡住莲花族的进攻，赢得她们信任。

english: These flea-bitten miners make such terrible use of their freedom. If we destroy their towns and kill the rabble, surely they'll take note of the Serpent's power.
chinese: 这些满身跳蚤的矿工，把自由糟蹋得一塌糊涂。摧毁他们的城镇，杀光那些乌合之众，他们就该知道灵蛇族有多强大了。

english: The Lotus and their feeble tricks sicken me - kill them all and raze their towns and we can move on to Serpentholm.
chinese: 莲花族那些软弱的伎俩令我作呕——杀光他们，夷平城镇，我们就能继续前往灵蛇城。
note: Serpentholm 暂译灵蛇城。

english: I can't remember a more glorious battle on these hallowed grounds - kill, raze and maim all that stand in our way and the seat of Serpent power will be secured once again!
chinese: 我不记得这片圣地有过比这更辉煌的战役——杀戮、焚毁、重创一切挡路者，灵蛇族的权力中心将再次稳固！

english: The Wolf Clan have moved to the forefront of our battle. We must decimate their forces and towns and reclaim this province as our own. We can now build a Keep to house our Zen Masters, so the clan can press on if I am injured.
chinese: 恶狼族已成为这场战争的主要敌人。我们必须重创他们的部队和城镇，把本省夺回来。现在我们能建造要塞供禅师驻守，即使我负伤，氏族也能继续前进。

english: This farce has gone on long enough. If we destroy their three shale mines and their place of magic, the Cairn, we can break the back of the Wolf Clan resistance. We can now build a Keep to house our Zen Masters, so the clan can press on if I am injured.
chinese: 这场闹剧该结束了。只要摧毁他们的三座页岩矿井，以及那座施法之所——石冢，就能瓦解恶狼族的抵抗。现在我们能建造要塞供禅师驻守，即使我负伤，氏族也能继续前进。

english: The Lotus's original treachery took place in this decrepit province, and it will be their final resting place - leave no man or building standing! We can now build a Keep to house our Zen Masters, so the clan can press on if I am injured.
chinese: 莲花族最初的背叛就发生在这个破败省份，这里也将成为他们最后的葬身之地——一个人、一座建筑都不要留下！现在我们能建造要塞供禅师驻守，即使我负伤，氏族也能继续前进。

english: I'm not the superstitious type, but something is wrong here. This area was said to be home to a benevolent Dragon, but something...darker is here now. My gaze is continually drawn to the top of the spire, and I believe I'll find some answers there. I must survive.
chinese: 我不是迷信的人，但这里有些不对劲。据说这一带曾有一条仁慈的龙，如今却出现了某种……更黑暗的东西。我的目光总不由自主地投向尖塔顶端，我相信答案就在那里。我必须活下来。

english: This Necromancer will be a powerful ally, indeed - enemies that die in his presence are immediately recruited to our service as undead warriors. We have no peasants to build a town, but the Necromancer's powers should suffice to wipe out Otomo's pitiful rebels.
chinese: 这名死灵法师将是一位强大的盟友——在他身边死去的敌人会立刻变成亡灵战士，为我们效力。我们没有农民建造城镇，但凭他的力量，应该足以消灭 Otomo 那群可怜的叛军。
note: Necromancer 沿用术语基线死灵法师。

english: The traitor Otomo must die, as must his pathetic Wolf allies. Otomo is nowhere to be seen now, but he is sure to emerge if we slay enough of his friends.
chinese: 叛徒 Otomo 必须死，他那些可悲的恶狼族盟友也一样。现在还看不到 Otomo，但只要杀够他的朋友，他一定会现身。

english: So the Wolf want to enlist the Ninja's aid, do they? If we protect the Soul Flame from the Wolf the Ninja should join us instead. Or...we could probably catch the Ninja unprepared and destroy the Soul Flame first...
chinese: 恶狼族想争取忍者相助，是吗？只要保护魂火，不让恶狼族毁掉它，忍者应该会转而加入我们。或者……我们也许能趁忍者没有防备，先摧毁魂火……

english: With the Ninja on our side, it's time we eradicated the remaining Wolf forces.
chinese: 忍者已站到我们这边，现在该消灭恶狼族剩下的部队了。

english: These petulant Monks just don't know when to stop. If we demolish their precious monastery, we should have no trouble crushing their spirits and "convincing" them to join our cause. We can't build a town, but our starting forces should be adequate.
chinese: 这些任性的僧侣真是不知适可而止。只要拆掉他们珍爱的寺院，打垮他们的斗志，“说服”他们加入我们就不难了。我们无法建造城镇，但初始兵力应该足够。

english: This one province stands between me and Grayback. Liquidate the Wolf forces here and we'll be on our way.
chinese: 只剩这一个省份挡在我与 Grayback 之间。清除这里的恶狼族部队，我们就能继续上路。

english: The rebel Grayback is breathing his last breaths. Attacking his forces should draw him from the Keep. If we kill him the pathetic Wolf Clan will dissolve and we can recover the Serpent's Orb at long last.
chinese: 叛军 Grayback 已是强弩之末。攻击他的部队，应该能把他从要塞引出来。只要杀了他，可悲的恶狼族便会瓦解，我们终于能夺回巨蛇宝珠。

english: If we fight this abominable swarm of Hordelings their leader is sure to appear. Once this "Nightvol" reveals itself, we must kill it to complete our subjugation of this land.
chinese: 只要与这群可憎的 Hordelings 交战，他们的首领一定会出现。等那个“Nightvol”现身，我们必须杀死它，才能完成对这片土地的征服。
note: Hordelings 与 Nightvol 均暂留英文，需统一专名。

english: Our cruel taskmaster, Budo, has refused to feed his workers for many days. We must not let him starve us, or we won't have the strength to rebel against our masters! Budo claims he'll give us a sack of rice if we break some shale for him. We'll see if he lives up to his promises.
chinese: 残酷的监工 武堂 已多日不肯给工人食物。不能让他把我们饿垮，否则我们就没有力气反抗主人！武堂 声称，只要替他凿下一些页岩，就给我们一袋稻米。且看他是否守信。

english: I had hoped to plan out our liberation more than this, but my hand has been forced; the time is now. We'll start our rebellion by freeing all of the slaves in this part of the mines.
chinese: 我原想更周密地筹划解放行动，可形势逼得我不得不动手——就是现在。先救出矿井这一带的所有奴隶，揭开反抗的序幕。

english: Budo set us up, and now we're the target of Yvaine's limitless ire. This certainly complicates things - escaping from the deep mines will not be easy. All of this must wait, though...I'd best break down this shale pile before Yvaine changes her mind and kills us.
chinese: 武堂 设下圈套，如今我们成了 Yvaine 怒火的目标。事情麻烦了——要从深矿里逃出去可不容易。不过这些都得先放一边……我最好赶在 Yvaine 改变主意、杀死我们之前，打碎这堆页岩。

english: It's good to have Longtooth at my side again - we'll need his strength as we fight for liberation. Magic barriers and other obstacles stand in our way, but we must reach the other side of this part of the mines. The air is cleaner here and there's a faint smell of trees...freedom is near!
chinese: Longtooth 再次与我并肩，真好——争取自由少不了他的力量。魔法屏障和其他障碍挡着路，但我们必须抵达这片矿井的另一侧。这里的空气更清新，还隐隐有树木的气息……自由近在眼前！

english: That witch and her cursed magicks! I've been trapped here, alone...at least my men escaped safely. There's another exit around here somewhere, so it's just a matter of finding it. I've never been in this part of the mines before, but if Yvaine's here I expect she'll be attended by plenty of Lotus warriors. I'm sure there are more slaves nearby, and I'll need their help if I'm to succeed.
chinese: 那个女巫，还有她该死的魔法！我被独自困在这里……至少我的手下安全逃了出去。附近一定还有另一个出口，只要找到它就行。我从没来过矿井的这一带，不过既然 Yvaine 在这里，莲花族战士肯定少不了。附近应该还有更多奴隶；若要成功，我需要他们的帮助。

english: I've escaped from the mines, much to the relief of my fellow Wolves. Just in time, too - we're under attack by Lotus troops! Fortunately, Longtooth is waiting nearby with reinforcements. If our Pitch Slinger signals from the tower above, Longtooth will see his flames and join forces with us. Then we can take the fight to Yvaine herself...
chinese: 我终于逃出了矿井，同胞们也松了口气。真是及时——莲花族部队正向我们进攻！幸好 Longtooth 带着援军在附近待命。只要我们的沥青投掷手从上方塔楼发信号，Longtooth 就会看到火光，加入我们。接下来，就能主动迎战 Yvaine 了……

english: The snow continues unabated. Even Gaihla's Sanctuary, known for its hot springs, has frozen over. Utara and her Witches are attacking Gaihla's Druidesses and Dryads. We must protect Gaihla's people and defeat Utara, or all is lost - we can set up a town on the western terrace.
chinese: 大雪仍下个不停。以温泉闻名的 Gaihla 圣地也已冰封。Utara 和她的女巫正在攻击 Gaihla 的女祭师与 Dryad。我们必须保护 Gaihla 的人，击败 Utara，否则就全完了——西面的台地可以建造城镇。
note: Dryad 属新增单位，暂留英文。

english: We must hold out until Grayback returns. This invisible laboratory must be hiding Gaihla. With just the two of us, though, things are going to be tricky. If we push boulders and destroy enough buildings, surely the commotion will delay the town's disappearance.
chinese: 我们必须坚持到 Grayback 回来。Gaihla 一定被藏在那座隐形实验室里。可我们只有两个人，事情会很棘手。只要推动巨石并摧毁足够多的建筑，造成的骚动应该能拖延城镇消失。

english: Wildeye has done well, but I hope that we're not too late. Gaihla is trapped inside that abominable laboratory, and it's up to us to tear it down and remove her from its twisted confines.
chinese: Wildeye 干得不错，但愿我们还不算太迟。Gaihla 被困在那座可憎的实验室里，我们得把它拆了，让她离开那个扭曲的牢笼。

english: After her ordeal in Soban's Laboratory and the long trek through the blizzard, Gaihla is in bad shape. There's an abandoned monastery to the west where she can rest safely. We'll take shelter in the monastery until she recovers, and then press on towards Yvaine's stronghold. Be wary...Wildeye suspects a trap.
chinese: 经历 Soban 实验室的折磨，又在暴风雪中长途跋涉，Gaihla 的状况很差。西边有座废弃寺院，她可以在那里安全休息。我们会留在寺院，等她恢复后再向 Yvaine 的据点进发。要小心……Wildeye 怀疑这是个陷阱。

english: At the monastery, we met a half-monk, half-ninja named Tao. He spoke strangely, but I don't think he's any crazier than Wildeye - for what that's worth! Tao claims that if we defeat the sorcerors Issyl and Koril, we'll be able to walk right through Yvaine's magical barriers. We may as well trust him. After all, what choice do we have?
chinese: 我们在寺院遇到一个半僧侣、半忍者的人，名叫 Tao。他说话古怪，不过要我说，他未必比 Wildeye 更疯——这话分量也有限！Tao 声称，只要击败巫师 Issyl 和 Koril，我们就能直接穿过 Yvaine 的魔法屏障。不妨信他一次。毕竟，我们还有别的选择吗？

english: Our progress has been halted by Taro - a spoiled, soft-minded brat if I ever met one. Unfortunately, he's also the heir to the Serpent Empire, so killing him isn't an option. Good thing he's a coward. Without his father's elite guards, I expect he'll run straight home to Daddy. There are three Royal Academies producing these guards, and we'll need to destroy them all...
chinese: Taro 挡住了去路——我从未见过这么被宠坏又没头脑的小鬼。不幸的是，他也是灵蛇帝国的继承人，不能杀。好在他是个胆小鬼。没有父亲的精锐卫兵保护，我料他会直奔家里，找爸爸求救。共有三座皇家学院训练这些卫兵，我们必须全部摧毁……
note: Royal Academy 暂译皇家学院，待建筑名称统一。

english: The end of our struggle is near. Yvaine's Keep is at the top of the mountain, protected by more of those accursed magical barriers. If we destroy the towns surrounding her Keep, the barriers should fall. Then we'll need to tear apart the Keep itself...and settle our feud with Yvaine, once and for all.
chinese: 这场斗争快到尽头了。Yvaine 的要塞就在山顶，周围还有那些可恨的魔法屏障保护。只要摧毁要塞周围的城镇，屏障应该就会消失。接下来，我们要拆掉要塞本身……并与 Yvaine 彻底了结恩怨。

english: How fitting that this campaign would end in a cave. After I kill Yvaine, this will all be over. I can smell her fetid presence through the dense, frozen air, but something's different about it...
chinese: 这场战役在洞穴里结束，倒也合适。杀死 Yvaine 后，一切就结束了。我隔着冰冷浓密的空气都能闻到她腐臭的气息，可其中似乎有些不一样……

english: Seven years away from the land had changed him.  When he spoke, he was always heard, and where he walked, the people followed.
chinese: 离开这片土地的七年改变了他。他一开口，众人便倾听；他走到哪里，人们便追随到哪里。

english: -- "The Dragon's Return," from "Serpent's Skin: A History of the Clan"
chinese: ——《龙之归来》，摘自《蛇之皮：氏族史》
note: 书名暂译，属引语出处而非官方书名。

english: You would be more useful to me, Otomo, if you were a callous man.
chinese: Otomo，要是你心肠再硬一些，对我会更有用。
要我向那个孩子低头？绝不！

english: Ours is a fertile land, rich and good.  The Serpent Clan is truly blessed.
chinese: 我们的土地肥沃富饶。灵蛇族真是得天独厚。
note: 阵营译名按用户决定统一

english: Servant, master, then servant again - ah, well, it is the way of things.
chinese: 先为仆，再为主，转眼又成仆人——唉，世事就是如此。

english: Heavens - that man's dead!  Doesn't this game have any rules?
chinese: 天哪，那个人死了！这比赛难道没有规则吗？

english: -- Lady Oja at the Wolfball Tournament
chinese: ——狼球锦标赛上的 Oja 夫人

english: When and how the Lotus wizards came to the land is a great mystery.  But once they were here, they were everywhere, whispering in the ear of even the most insignificant Serpent noble.
chinese: 莲花族的巫师何时、如何来到这片土地，至今仍是个谜。可他们一来，就无处不在，甚至对最不起眼的灵蛇族贵族也耳语不停。
note: 已确认氏族名称；引语上下文指氏族而非动物或地名。

english: A horse?  A horse?  Of course, of course!
If the miners can dodge our whips, we haven't worked them hard enough.
chinese: 要是矿工能躲开我们的鞭子，那就是我们还没把他们逼得够狠。
